# OFFVYBE — Wear Your Own Vibe

> OFFVYBE is a contemporary luxury menswear house specializing exclusively in four architectural silhouettes: Oversized, Jeans, Boxy Fit, and Jackets. Built with natural European noble fibers and Japanese shuttle-loom selvedge denim.

## Core Silhouettes & Collections
- [Oversized Drops](/oversized): 320gsm–520gsm heavyweight loopback cotton hoodies, dropped-shoulder tees, and relaxed flannels milled in Hamamatsu, Japan.
- [Okayama Selvedge Jeans](/jeans): 14oz–15oz redline selvedge denim woven on vintage Toyoda shuttle looms with relaxed wide-leg and carpenter stacking.
- [Boxy Fit Geometry](/boxy-fit): 220gsm mercerized poplin overshirts and 7-gauge Italian extra-fine merino wool mock-necks cropped at the natural waistline.
- [Structural Jackets](/jackets): Tuscan lambskin suede MA-1 bombers, 16oz rugged duck canvas workwear jackets, and full-grain Italian leather moto cuts.
- [Atelier Heritage](/about): Brand philosophy, provenance, and sustainable craftsmanship standards.

## Brand Specifications
- Primary Color Palette: Deep Burgundy (#4A1216), Crimson Highlight (#6B1D24), Dark Espresso Shadow (#2B080A), Warm Ivory (#F9F6F4), Champagne Gold (#C5A880).
- Based in: India (online store; prices in INR, GST included).
- Delivery: across India; free on orders of ₹1,999 or more. Cash on delivery on serviceable PIN codes.
- Returns: 30-day doorstep exchange (see /returns).
